caption: The drawing features a cylindrical tin container with a lid situated above a separate sketch of the lid viewed from above. The tin is predominantly dark with green, yellow, orange, and red decorative designs. The upper portion of the tin has a wide yellow and green vine or leaf pattern band that encircles it. Below this band, there is a prominent horizontal panel featuring a stylized floral motif with green leaves and red-orange flowers and fruits against a brown background. The main lid is greyish in color with shading, has a handle loop at the top, and a metal latch at the side. The lower part of the drawing displays a detailed pencil rendering of the lid, showing its embossed or engraved radial pattern and the latch mechanism extending to the left. The illustration is rendered on a plain, light-colored background, and is signed with text reading "DONALD HUMPHREY 1937" at the bottom.
title: Toleware Tin Cannister
